section.title: Market position and reception
section.para: Coverage of Collibra has often treated the company as part of a wider enterprise shift toward making data more discoverable, reliable, and governable across large organizations. Publications have described the company in varying terms, including data governance, data management, and data intelligence, while consistently placing it in the market for enterprise software used to control and operationalize data. Later coverage connected that position to AI governance and data-access controls as those topics became more prominent in enterprise software.
